name: Ann Coulter
role: American conservative columnist, author and television commentator
summary: Conservative polemicist who opposes abortion, same-sex marriage and amnesty, wants far lower immigration, favours free-market health care and a flat tax, and rejects the case for human-caused global warming. She backed military tribunals and a hard line on terrorism in 2001-02, and defends Trump against the Russia investigation.

sources.usedFor: Confirms her as a conservative commentator whose books and columns state her views

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: She defends stop-and-frisk policing as saving black lives and credits tough law-and-order policing in New York.

abortion-legal.rationale: She mocks the argument for legal abortion and calls it technically the killing.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: She calls birthright citizenship for children of illegal immigrants a scam with nothing to do with the original Constitution.

class-collaboration.rationale: She calls attempts to "gen up class warfare" against corporations a fraud, saying a corporation is only its shareholders, employees and employers.

death-penalty.rationale: She says capital punishment ought to be available for the gravest crimes, and faults terrorism prosecutions that did not obtain it.

decide-locally.rationale: She says the Constitution limits the federal government chiefly to national defense, not health care, schools or pensions, and welcomes a patchwork of state abortion laws as federalism.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: She says Latin American countries are not capable of self-government as the US is, and defends the US bossing them around under the Monroe Doctrine.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: She calls cap and trade a hidden tax to fight an imaginary phenomenon.

elite-replacement.rationale: She argues Democrats passed the 1965 act to change the voters, with Americans never consulted.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: She asks why America should belong to an organization that makes Syria head of its human rights commission, and rejects any need for the UN or a world body to authorize American action.

flat-income-tax.rationale: She says the country needs a simple system and a flat tax.

force-without-un.rationale: She says the US will not give France veto power over its self-defense and asks why America should need the UN to decide when it acts in its own interest.

human-caused-global-warming.rationale: She calls global warming an "imaginary phenomena" and argues scientists who disagree are hounded.

islam-incompatible.rationale: She writes that the number-one enemy of Western civilization today is Islam.

legalize-drugs.rationale: She defends tough drug laws against Rand Paul on legalization.

limit-guns.rationale: She credits the Second Amendment for fewer mass shootings per capita and notes that 98 percent of mass shootings occur in gun-free zones.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: She argues a free market in insurance would make it cheap and abolishing government interventions would fix about 95 percent of the problem.

member-state-blocks-federal-overreach.rationale: She praises Eisenhower and Kennedy for sending troops to compel state officials to obey federal law and says sanctuary states defy Supreme Court rulings.

minority-language-support.rationale: She lists bilingual teachers, doctors, court translators and other legally mandated services for non-English speakers as costs that harm the country.

more-religion-public.rationale: She protests the removal of Ten Commandments displays and attacks the push to drop "under God" from the Pledge.

open-borders.rationale: She demands a fence, employer sanctions and an end to amnesty, and says the American worker wants no more immigration.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: She opposes letting gay people serve openly, saying sexuality should not influence young men defending the nation and that the rules should not be changed.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: She condemns the removal of Confederate monuments and memorials as airbrushing history, comparing it to the Taliban.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: She laments that immigration is turning the country into some other country without Americans being consulted.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: She attributes black disadvantage to liberal policies that subsidized illegitimacy rather than to racism.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: She argues a minimum wage hike costs jobs and screws the people it claims to help.

reduce-immigration.rationale: She says the American worker wants no more immigration, legal or illegal, and her column blames the 1965 act for admitting far too many.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: She writes that there is no "hate speech" exception to the First Amendment and that hate-crime prosecutions for speech are prosecutions for Bad Thought.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: She asks how teaching Afghan girls to read benefits her and says she does not want it on her credit card; US effort should go to building our own nation.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: She says on air she opposes gay marriage and argues marriage requires a mother and a father.

school-vouchers.rationale: She attacks Democrats for opposing school vouchers and notes that 60 percent of blacks support them.

separate-church-state.rationale: She argues a Ten Commandments monument does not establish religion and that the First Amendment lets states establish one, calling the US a country founded on a compact with God.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: She lists sex education classes with condom videos among objectionable taxpayer-funded speech.

strong-leader.rationale: She says the Constitution gave the energetic, fast-moving president authority to act where Congress takes forever, and praises a strong executive in command of federal troops.

surveillance-ok.rationale: She faults the FBI for not seeking a FISA warrant on a terror suspect while seeking four on Carter Page.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: She asks where the massive tariffs on Chinese goods and Buy American programs are, faulting the president for not imposing them.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: She argues for a single flat tax and calls attempts to make corporations and the rich pay more class warfare.

traditional-family.rationale: She says civilization requires the family, a married mother and father raising children, and blames the state for destroying the black family.

unions-good.rationale: She calls public sector unions a ratchet on costs run by thug techniques and says unions misled workers on immigration.

universal-healthcare.rationale: She opposes the Obama health law, wants it repealed, and favours a free market with only a limited fund for catastrophes.

voter-id.rationale: She defends voter ID laws against the charge of racism and attacks federal bills that would bar states from requesting voter ID.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: She says the number of immigrants who should be on welfare is zero, since no country should admit people who need monetary support.

work-for-welfare.rationale: She says welfare reform, which Republicans pushed for years, helped black people most of all.

notes: Evidence is her own words: the book Resistance Is Futile (2018), columns on townhall.com and anncoulter.com (2005-2026) and CNN transcripts (2001-2014, via the MediaSum corpus). Themes searched: immigration, abortion, marriage, religion, courts, guns, speech, taxes, unions, welfare, foreign policy and the UN, executive power, federalism. Most statements stay null: she has no stated position on them in the sources read (monarchy, secession, class theory, voting systems, most economy-structure statements). Her 2001 words on torture conflict with later ones, so it is null.
